The '''fingerprint masque''' was a device used to fool biometric fingerprint scanners.<ref name="FC">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

Consisting of a thin, liquid-crystal biometric screen applied to the fingertip, the fingerprint masque created a random or known fingerprint pattern.<ref name="FC" /> Advanced masques could be embedded with false [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] in order to circumvent sophisticated biometric scanners and readers.<ref name="FC" />
